17+Intense Violence, Blood and GorePublishers of games you launch receive access to your XBOX profile information and associated data while you play. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionInspired by the breakneck pace of the glory days of late-'90s shooters, you play as a hobo trying to rescue his dog from the clutches of the Nazis. Fast, brutal, and demanding. Darkenstein 3D doesn’t make it easy for you. You can dodge enemy projectiles, but surviving requires quick movements, precise aim, and sharp reflexes. Every battle is a deadly dance of dodges and spins. No cover, no aim assist—just pure, unadulterated action. Conquer 13 hand-designed levels that progressively increase in difficulty. Explore castles, caves, valleys, and desert villages. Unlock doors with hidden keys, uncover secrets, hunt for treasure, and keep racking up higher and higher scores. The game features 23 types of enemies spread across various factions. Gory explosions, ragdoll physics, and shootouts filled with debris: every shot feels impactful, and every death looks painful. Enemies fly, disintegrate, and crumble in a glorious bloodbath as the battlefield collapses around you. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionHenry Gray is haunted by the ghosts of his past. He awakens in 1977 inside Paul Staderbeiger Psychiatric Hospital, about to begin a maddening journey that will push his sanity to the breaking point. Descend through derelict hospital halls and beyond, where reality and nightmare mix into something far worse than either. A Descent Into Madness Henry enters a horrifying world of blood and pain, hunted by guards and monsters. The hospital is only the beginning of a journey into nightmarish places that may be real, or creations of Gray's broken mind. Piece together the truth of his tragic past, fight back when cornered with improvised weapons, and break out only to fall into even darker places from Henry's past. Chilling Uncertainty Every puzzle solved, clue collected, and enemy left behind brings Henry closer to answers he may not want. Explore a decrepit asylum, cruel laboratories, and other horrific locations while facing enemies outside and demons within. Someone is guiding Henry deeper into insanity. Are they helping, or leading him to harm? Sophisticated Voice Integration Fire and Ashes can be played without a microphone, but the full experience uses voice recognition that reacts to your breathing, whispers, screams, and words. Hold your breath to avoid attention, shout to lure monsters away, taunt guards to create openings in brutal melee, and master the Electric Voice pacification tool to subdue dangerous patients and the monsters hunting you.Show morePublished byAxyos GamesDeveloped byASDstudioPlay withXBOX Series X|SCapabilities4K Ultra HDSingle player60 fps+Spatial SoundOptimized for Xbox Series X|SConsole Keyboard & MouseXbox achievementsXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
